title: S03T03 - Implement per-record conflict, deletion, and event-log reconciliation
description: Resolve non-overlapping changes automatically, surface same-record conflicts explicitly, preserve tombstones, and deterministically repair or rechain append-only history.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-overlapping records merge without loss; divergent changes to the same record produce a typed reviewable conflict.
Tombstones, relationship edges, readiness projections, and hash-linked events survive exchange without silent resurrection or deletion.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
